body: Founder asked how to get MJOLNIR installed on their Android tablet; answered live, then asked to add that walkthrough to the README. Content was already there -- restructured into explicit Step 1 (only the founder can do: add the real GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON secret) vs Step 2 (tablet-only download/install), and refreshed the stale run-count (was citing run #4, live CI check showed run #5 as the current failure, same blocker). Commits f6235b8 (readme) + 157ee02 (changelog).
title: MJOLNIR README: clearer install-blocker step split
